title: How to tie a tie - Quick and Easy

comments.cleanedText: I have never been able to tie a tie or understand how to in my life. I just tied my first tie in 1:34 seconds and I'm 28! I'm so pumped
Btw guy who posted “video starts on 0:30” I owe you a like brother 😂
1:29 When I pull the narrow end of the tie it becomes longer than the wide end wtf
1:37 "make sure everything is straight" Alas, just not my son

Mine looks amazing, thank you. I already had the concept but evry time I would do it, it wouldn’t come out right. The game changer was how you show us where to place the long part of the tye after forming the knot. You don’t place it in between, you place it in front within the knot itself 1:02 . If you place it within both knots or between it won’t be able to be adjusted and it will make the tye knot deformed and permanently stuck. Once the tye is formed 1:50 it should have the ability to be adjusted and have room for agility 1:06 1:18
